caseNameFull: Thomas v. United States and Thomas v. Rossetter
attorneys: Mr. Lloyd C. Whitman for petitioner. Mr. Isaac E. Ferguson for respondents in No. 643. Mr. Charles Liebman filed a brief on behalf of the Chicago Civil Liberties Committee, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.
